notes.title: Beta Patch 10
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to Beta Patch 10!  This patch focuses mainly on low level balance and level gen.


Level Gen:

Tweaked spawning table.  Earlier levels now spawn slightly higher level monsters.  This should reduce the amount of time spent fighting bats and goblins in early game.

Lairs spawn one monster every 7 to 10 turns instead of once per turn with a 10% chance.
Maximum lairs per level decreased a bit to compensate for this.
Maximum initial enemies per level decreased.
(These changes are meant to incentivize more aggressive playstyles, and punish slow defensive ones)

Increased variety of terrain generation- smaller levels are now more common, tight mazelike levels are rarer, and there will more often be multiple paths between any two given points in the level.

Level 1 now has 4 monsters and a lair instead of just 5 monsters to better teach the game to new players.


Spells:

Removed Spark and Flametongue.
Made Lightning and Fireball level 1 spells to replace them.
Spark and Flametongue did not feel good to use, Fireball and Lightning Bolt are a much better introduction to the game.
Their stats have been adjusted to be reasonable level 1 spells.


Monsters:

Satyr Refresh cooldown 1->2 (so he wont stand there healing whenever hes damaged now)
Mushboom damage 0->1 (to avoid the softlock)

Added Chaos Chimera, Deathchill Chimera, and Starfire Chimera: mid sized monsters with alternating elemental ranged attacks that split into lion and snake when killed.

Kings summon 2 lairs instead of 3
Banners decrease spawn time by 1 turn instead of impacting spawn chance


Misc:
Added projectile sprites- little elemental ones for elemental attacks, arrows for kobolds, more to come later
Made Vampires and other shapeshifters shapeshift instantly instead of after the current spell (so now you can, for instance, kill a vampire and its bat with one annihilate.)
Realms now index from 1 instead of 0
Fixed some erroneous references to SP as XP (Thanks esty8nine for finding this one)
Made low hp flash bigger and more obvious
Added rich presence display so all your friends can see what level you are on
Fixed bug where you could make a zombie savefile by closing the game as you died, which would crash the game if you tried to continue (Thanks travv0 for finding this one)
Updated How to Play text

Thanks to all who played the Rift Wizard Festival Beta Demo, and to everyone who gave feedback that helped contribute to these changes!

notes.title: Beta Patch 6
notes.content:
This weeks patch features 2 new spell mechanics, and 5 new spells.

Added Channeled Spells.
Channeled spells can be repeatably cast by passing (pressing numpad 5).

New Spell: Plague of Filth.  Plague of Filth is a channeled conjuration spell which summons fly swarms and toads.  It doesn't deal much damage but its useful if you want to clog the level up with filth.

Meteor Shower is now a channeled spell, with each turn doing much less than before.  It can be channeled for up to 5 turns.

Lightning Bolt can be upgrade into a channeled spell.

Fixed bug where summoned faeries could not fly.

Heavenly Idol
No longer heals players

Fixed a bug that prevented conjure memories from working on spells with upgraded max charges, and fixed the charges regained upgrade (it didn't do anything previously)

Added Orbs.
Orbs are like what void star was, but they are units instead of clouds.  Making them clouds was super weird and led to confusing questions like "what happens when a spider tries to make a web over a void star".
Orbs units have no ai and will always try to move towards their target.  If blocked by walls they will simply hover, if blocked by a unit they will swap with it.
Orbs are immune to most damage types and cannot be buffed or debuffed.
Mousing over an orb will show its (current) destination.

Void Star is an orb now.
Added Searing Orb- Scorches all in LOS of the moving orb for low fire damage.  Explodes upon reaching its target for higher fire damage.  Vulnerable to ice.
Added Glass Orb- Glassifies enemies near the orb each turn.  Explodes upon reaching its target for medium physical damage.  Can be upgraded to shield allies, and to emit large glassification/shield pulses when retargeted.  Vulnerable to physical damage, be careful of kobolds.
Added Ball Lightning- Emits lightning bolts to a few random enemies in LOS each turn.  Creates a nova upon reaching target.  Can be upgraded to emit a magnetic pulse when retargeted, dealing damage to constructs and lightning creatures.  Vulnerable to other lightning.
Added Orb control- a spell that retargets and refreshes duration on your active orbs.
Added Orb Lord- a lord skill for orb spells.

Arcane combustion tags AS -> A
Arcane combustion no longer makes floors over chasms.

Shielded Minions gives 3 shields instead of 1 to arcane minions.

Ghostfire tags FD -> FDC
Ghostfire level 7->5

Reverted distance formula to euclidean from taxicab.

Enemy AI: Enemies will no longer walk towards temporary summons.  They might still shoot at them though.

Enveloping Shrine now gives radius to any spell, not just fire or dark

Wyrms are now living.
Aelves are now lightning creatures.

notes.title: Beta Patch 3
notes.content:
This weeks patch focuses on making summons a bit less overpowering, making healing more rare, and making the early game a bit scrappier, and making sorcery focused builds a bit more viable.

Level 5->4

Hungry Maw 
charges 9 -> 6

Added Mystic Power spell.  This spell gives the player a temporary bonus to all spell damage.  It does not normally stack in intensity, but, it can be upgraded to do so.

Word spells are now all also sorcery spells.  It was weird that all the high level sorcery style spells were not counted as sorceries.

Made the more powerful lvl 1 spells lvl 2 spells.  There was, honestly, never a reason to not get fireball and lightning bolt in a build before.  These 2 spells often became the only spell worth casting in a player's spellbook.

notes.title: Beta Patch 1
notes.content:
Hello beta testers!

I'm going to start posting patch notes in the steam patch notes section in preperation for release.  To that effect, patch notes for todays update:

Added 16 new monsters, with an emphasis on early monsters.

Synced item and shrine animations to character animations.  Were still working on these, expect continued iteration on item and shrine graphics.

Some UI polish

Fixed several crashes

Changed idol of beauty to heal allies instead of healing all living units (it was too complicated before)

Added 5 new tilesets

Ctrl now shows red outlines on enemies that can attack the highlighted tile

Player auto pathing no longer paths the player into portals or shrines

Balance:

Shrines give 25% duration bonuses instead of 15% duration bonuses.

Blinding light max charges 4 -> 3
Blinding light level 4 -> 5
Blinding light was a bit too good, now its a bit less good.  It might still be too good, Ive got my eye on it.

Fiery Justice
Now converts Fire -> Holy rather than Holy -> Fire.
Holy magic does lots of stuff- it doesnt need to also deal lots of damage.
Fire magic on the other hand, should definitly deal lots of damage.

Heal minions max charges 14 -> 8.  I rarely used all 14 charges before using a mana potion, but when I did, it was really stupid, and I felt like a healer from an MMO.

Imp Call minion duration 15 -> 11.  Imp call is ann awesome 'build around me' spell and I love building around it.  It shouldnt also be a great general purpose spell to get early on.

Giant Bear level 3 -> 2
Removed Dire Wolf
-> Dire Wolf and wolf were too similar, giant bear can more or less take its place now

Holy Flame now deals fire damage in a vertical line and holy damage in a horizontal line.  The lines length increases with the radius stat.

Annihilate cascade range cost 4 -> 3.  There are far fewer libraries that discount this now that it is only a chaos spell and not a fire/lightning spell.
Mega Annihilate cascade range cost 6 -> 4.  Ditto.
SealFate charges 5 -> 13.  No reason for this spell to have such a low charge count, im still not sure itll find much use at 13, we shall see.

Volcano blindcasting upgrade cost 3 -> 2
